The Chinese Year Book 1937

1937 Issue (Third Year of Publication)
Council of International Affairs, Nanking; printed and distributed by the Commercial Press, Shanghai, 1937

Only tables and columnar lists are transcribed; prose, advertisements, maps, graphs and the index are not. Pages with tables were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5, which also flagged pages printed sideways (turned upright before reading), very dense tables and tables continued over pages. A table running over several pages was read in one call with all its pages, up to eight pages (six for dense tables); longer runs were read in parts and joined where the column headings match. Each page was read once and not checked by eye; unreadable figures are marked [?], and printed totals that do not add up are noted and kept as read. The contents were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5.
